channel.title: Customer Wars
channel.desc: In Duluth, Georgia, an officer catches a customer allegedly using a borrowed police badge to get free snacks. In Lancaster, Pennsylvania, a driver jumps into her car mid-tow and tries to drive it off the lift. In Barranquilla, Colombia, passengers step in when a suspected thief's exit is blocked by a quick-thinking driver. In St. Louis, Missouri, a woman wards off would-be thieves with a decoy package filled with an unpleasant surprise.
